newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,108 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,108 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 1,108 contracts, compared with 695 contracts traded overnight Thursday, according to the CBOT.
There were 122 wheat, 567 corn, 368 soybean, 36 soymeal, 10 soyoil and 5 oats contracts traded, with 19 corn put, 17 corn call, 8 soybean put and 20 soymeal put options.

In overnight trading, corn was 3/4 cent higher to 1/4 cent per bushel lower, wheat up 1/4 cent, soybeans down 3 to 4-1/2 cents, soyoil down 0.01 cent per lb, soymeal down 20 cents a ton, and oats steady to up 1/4 cent per bushel.
